comments.text: The issue here is grok 4.2 is taking bets which are profitable 9/10 times but the one time they are losing bets the outcome is losing 100% of your account (or more, since leveraged). This is like a baby version of black swan / tail-risks events that cause 99.9999% of traders to lose all their capital within 5-10 years of starting. You (generally) have to be a fairly sophisticated hedge fund to be able to compute where exactly the risk lies and balance the portfolio (hedge) such that you both avoid these extreme tail risks and outperform a simple sp500 index fund.

comments.text: I was a quant for ~7 yrs (currently in big tech working on Search, AI etc). Any short term financial trading results are highly prone to dumb luck. Financial returns are heavy tailed. Also these kind of high frequency (intraday) trading strategies tend to be capacity limited. Cheers.
